# Cypress Component Tester Skill

> **Category:** Tech Skills > QA > Cypress

## Overview

Implements component testing with Cypress for React, Vue, and Angular components with proper mounting and interaction testing

## Quick Start

1. Copy this skill folder to your workspace under `.github/skills/`
2. Reference in agent files: `skills: [cypress-component-tester-skill]`
3. The skill activates automatically when the agent is invoked

## Structure

```text
cypress-component-tester-skill/
  SKILL.md    # Skill definition with procedures and standards
  GUIDE.md    # This guide
```

## Companion Agent

This skill is designed to work with the `@cypress-component-tester` agent from the Independent Agents catalogue.

## Key Capabilities

- Mount React, Vue, and Angular components
- Test component props and events
- Configure component providers and context
- Test component visual appearance

## Technology Standards Applied

- **Component Testing**: Cypress component testing configuration
- **Mount Configuration**: Provider and context setup for mounting
- **Visual Testing**: Component visual verification
